market_view: Calm but rate-pressured regime: VIX 15.7, 10y yield at a 52-week high of 5.16% and the dollar firm; AI stocks still bid but an Oracle force majeure notice unsettled AI bulls. Crude whipsaws between US-Iran peace talk headlines and fresh Houthi attacks on Saudi facilities.

oil_gas.catalyst: none (mixed): 'Oil prices jump after Yemen's Houthis claim attacks on Saudi facilities' (Al Jazeera) is offset by 'Oil prices slide about 2% as US, Iran explore path out of war' (Yahoo Finance) and 'Saudi Arabia crude oil exports hit highest level since Iran war began' (CNBC)
oil_gas.reasoning: Houthi claims are not a confirmed supply loss and Saudi exports are at a war-time high; peace talks advancing. Storyline fading; late entries in this episode have done worse. Flat.

gold_miners.reasoning: 10y yield at a 52-week high, dollar firm, gold below $4,300 and falling; inflation expectations spike is pushing yields, not gold. Jobs report ahead adds variance only. No gold-specific catalyst.

chips.catalyst: none new; existing NVDA hold from 2026-09-17 runs to about 10-01. Counter-headline: 'Why Oracle's force majeure notice is freaking out AI bulls' (Yahoo Finance)
chips.reasoning: Huang 2x chip guidance is already priced after a 10% sector rally; Oracle force majeure and Micron weakness are fresh AI-demand doubts. No new catalyst to renew; keep existing hold to its end.

pharma.catalyst: minor: 'FDA approves Lilly's Olumiant (baricitinib) for pediatric patients 12 years of age and older with severe alopecia areata' (Eli Lilly); existing LLY hold from 2026-09-22 runs to about 10-06
pharma.reasoning: Pediatric alopecia label is too small to move LLY; GLP-1 Medicare uptake catalyst is already being held. No reason to add a new call; TrumpRx pricing comparisons are a mild risk.

copper_uranium.catalyst: 'BHP halts giant Chile copper mine after worker death' (AFR, 2026-09-24): a fresh named supply outage on top of China tightness, copper 1.2% below its 52-week high; FCX still -8.8% over 20 days so the outage is not fully priced
copper_uranium.reasoning: New supply shock to copper while the market is already tight; renews the FCX hold. Peru projects are long-dated supply and do not offset near term. Exit on mine restart or China demand slump.

would_change_my_mind: A quick restart of the BHP Chile mine or a copper inventory release; a confirmed Saudi output loss would reopen oil; a yield reversal below 5% would reopen gold.

handoff.what_changed: WTI 94.61 (-7.2% over 5d) on US-Iran peace talks and record Saudi exports, though Houthis claim attacks on Saudi facilities lifted it +2.7% on the day. 10y yield hit a 52-week high of 5.16%, gold below $4,300. BHP halted a giant Chile copper mine after a worker death; Oracle force majeure notice spooked AI bulls; FDA approved LLY Olumiant for pediatric alopecia.

oil_gas.why: Houthi claims are not a confirmed supply loss; peace talks and record Saudi exports dominate.

gold_miners.why: 10y at a 52-week high and firm dollar; no gold catalyst.

chips.why: Held from Huang guidance call to about 10-01; not renewed given Oracle force majeure doubts.

pharma.why: Medicare GLP-1 uptake (700k seniors, 70% Lilly); not renewed today, Olumiant approval is minor.

copper_uranium.why: Renewed: BHP halts giant Chile copper mine after worker death (AFR), copper near record; confidence 0.53.

open_storylines.note: Peace talks advanced, Saudi exports at war-time high; Houthis claim attacks on Saudi facilities. Re-enter XOM only on a confirmed named supply loss; a deal closes it.

open_storylines.name: XOM lagging crude
open_storylines.note: XOM -0.7% over 5d with WTI -7.2%; watch windfall tax, export curbs.

open_storylines.name: Yields, inflation and the Fed
open_storylines.note: 10y 5.16% at 52-week high; consumer inflation expectations spiked. Jobs report within 20 days. Gold headwind.

open_storylines.name: AI demand, NVDA
open_storylines.note: Huang 2x chips vow vs Oracle force majeure notice and Micron decline. Exit NVDA on guidance cut or export hit; hold ends about 10-01.

open_storylines.name: Tariffs and trade war
open_storylines.note: Legality of tariffs questioned (CNN); watch copper, Cameco, pharma tariffs.

open_storylines.name: Lilly GLP-1 uptake and pricing
open_storylines.note: Medicare uptake strong; TrumpRx price comparisons a risk. Watch pricing policy, compounding, trials.

open_storylines.note: BHP Chile mine halted after worker death; copper near record on China tightness. Exit on mine restart, supply release or China demand slump. Peru projects are long-dated.

open_storylines.note: Niger uranium project cleared to resume; CCJ weak (-17.9% over 20d). No CCJ catalyst.

handoff.next_job: Next decision day: check FCX (BHP Chile mine restart, copper record, China data) held to about 10-09; LLY held to about 10-06 for pricing or GLP-1 news; NVDA ends about 10-01 (check Oracle/AI capex news); XOM flat unless a confirmed named supply loss; watch yields above 5% and the jobs report for gold.

lessons.rule: Hypothesis only: oil longs on a named supply-shock escalation win over 10 days; later entries in a long-running episode do worse.
Hypothesis only: LLY longs after a trial or guidance catalyst have a positive mean net return over 10 days.
Hypothesis only: copper longs on a fresh supply-squeeze headline win.
lessons.evidence: FCX 07-31 +5.91% (CNBC squeeze), 08-10 +10.09% (Reuters Congo ban). Continuations: 08-05 -0.68%, 08-13 +17.10%, 08-18 +9.02%. No new closed trades; 09-25 BHP halt entry is a new test.
